c74object.name: evi_ladder_poles
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. TPT nonlinear transistor Ladder filter emulation with switchable (interpolated) poles
c74object.description:
evi_ladder_poles is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_ladder_poles.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_ladder_poles is also available in MSP as: evi.ladder.poles~.
By default another 24dB Ladder emulation via piecewise approximation, but poles can be interpolated to a 18dB, 12dB and 6dB filter. These are not allpass aligned so technically incorrect, but sound interesting and can be useful. For a 'correct' 12dB ladder see evi.lorez~ (with a 'z').

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: In. Audio input to be filtered.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: @default 880. Cutoff frequency in Pitch or Hz (default) depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..2 @default 1. Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in tuning.

attribute.name: cutoffmode
attribute.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (default off).

attribute.name: shape
attribute.description: The 'shape' of the saturation. This attribute should be ignored and left at default.

attribute.name: shapesmooth
attribute.description: If shapesmooth > 0, the @shape attribute will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off and can be safely ignored.

attribute.name: slopesmooth
attribute.description: If slopesmooth > 0, the @slope attribute will be internally smoothed by this time.
